theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_rh_scaling_continuous
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (s : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → 0 < s → (∀ g : Euclidean N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → ∫ y, g (s⁻¹ • y) ∂μ = s ^ n * ∫ y, g y ∂μ) → ∀ g : Euclidean N → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → ∫ y, g (s⁻¹ • y) ∂μ = s ^ n * ∫ y, g y ∂μ
